scenes.heading: Use only the link formats each program allows

sents.d: Use only the link formats each program allows
A tidy shortened link isn't worth losing your affiliate account over.
Many programs, including Amazon, ban links that hide where they lead.
Break the rule and you can lose the account and any unpaid commissions.
Read each program's rules on link formats and shorteners before you share anything.
Use only the official or approved short links the program gives you.

take: Use official or approved links only. Disguised links can cost you your account.
